title: 7 Wonders: Duel
components: 73 Age cards (Age I, Age II, Age III)
setup: Place the board between players; set the Conflict pawn on the center zero space.
Place the 4 Military penalty tokens face-up on their matching track spaces.
Shuffle Progress tokens and place 5 face-up on the board; return remaining to the box.
Deal 4 Wonder cards to each player via the drafting procedure (4 total Wonders per player).
Arrange Age I cards in the designated overlapping pyramid structure (some face-up, some face-down).
procedure: Players alternate taking turns, selecting 1 completely exposed card (not covered by any other card) from the card display:
Option 1 - Construct the Building: Pay the coin or resource cost printed on the card and place it into your city.
Option 2 - Discard for Coins: Discard the card to the box and take 2 coins + 1 additional coin per yellow commercial building currently in your city.
Option 3 - Construct a Wonder: Pay the resource cost of 1 of your unbuilt Wonders, then tuck the drafted card face-down underneath that Wonder.
endGame: Instant Victory 1 (Military Supremacy): If the Conflict pawn ever pushes all the way into the opponent's capital space, the game ends immediately in victory.
Instant Victory 2 (Scientific Supremacy): If a player ever collects 6 different scientific symbols across their green cards, the game ends immediately in victory.

Civilian Victory (Age III End): If neither instant victory occurs by the end of Age III, sum up Victory Points across: Military track, Blue/Green/Yellow/Purple buildings, built Wonders, Progress tokens, and 1 VP per 3 coins in treasury.
⚖️ Tie-Breaker: Most Victory Points from blue Civilian buildings; if still tied, shared victory.
notes: The 7 Wonders Cap: Only 7 total Wonders can be built between both players! The moment a 7th Wonder is constructed across the board, the 8th unbuilt Wonder is discarded.
Trading Costs: If you lack a resource, you must purchase it from the bank for 2 coins + 1 additional coin for every matching resource symbol your opponent produces.
Chained Construction: Many cards feature symbol icons allowing free construction of matching advanced buildings in future Ages.
